hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

. ~/.zshenv 2>/dev/null; jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; ids=$(printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | sed -E 's/^.*bd close[[:space:]]+//' | awk '{out="";for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){if($i ~ /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*-[a-zA-Z0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$/){if(out=="")out=$i;else out=out","$i}else break}print out}'); if [ -n "$ids" ]; then nohup bd -C /Users/jnixon/rosterbot github sync --issues "$ids" >>/tmp/bd-github-sync.log 2>&1 & fi; }; exit 0

. ~/.zshenv 2>/dev/null; id=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < /Users/jnixon/rosterbot/.beads/last-touched 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$id" ]; then nohup bd -C /Users/jnixon/rosterbot github sync --issues "$id" >>/tmp/bd-github-sync.log 2>&1 & fi; exit 0
case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.env|*.env.*|*/.fantrax-cache/*|*/.cache/*) echo 'BLOCKED: refusing to edit sensitive/cache file' >&2; exit 1;; *) exit 0;; esac
hooks.description: Block edits to credential and cache files
